svg.title: Klarna marketing expense: 328 plus 28 plus 58 equals 414 million dollars
svg.desc: 2024 to 2025 rounded reported sales and marketing expense. Referral commissions increased 28 million and the remaining expense basket 58 million. Neither is an AI-only cash measure. The issuer separately prints an 87 million total change because values are rounded.
